critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2947 lines — well over the 700-line threshold. Recommend splitting into routers/modules (auth, admin, mlm, orders, site) for maintainability.
admin_dashboard uses N+1 queries in loops (14 count_documents + 7 find calls per request). Consider MongoDB aggregation pipeline for daily_stats/daily_users to reduce round-trips.

_pending_kit_order_id / pay_kit endpoint: reused=false path always fires — fine, but consider adding an index on orders (user_id, business_id, is_joining_order, payment_status) for perf as data grows.
log_audit swallows all exceptions with a bare try (line 147); a failure to write audit logs will silently pass. Consider logger.warning on exception.
